decisions.question: V-angle and bore × stroke?
decisions.rationale: Matches real production Toyota V35A. 60° gives natural primary balance.

decisions.question: Block construction & deck style?
decisions.chosen: Aluminum HPDC die-cast, open-deck, with cast-iron press-fit liners
decisions.rationale: A380, open-deck for cooling, gray-iron liners for serviceability.

decisions.question: Crankcase / main bearing architecture?
decisions.chosen: Bedplate (aluminum) bolted to block — modern stiffness optimum
decisions.rationale: Cross-bolted bedplate replaces individual main caps — stiffest crankcase.

decisions.question: Service/manufacturing approach?
chosen: 0.5 mm machining stock on critical surfaces
Casting features explicit: drafts, fillets, parting line, gating, witness marks
